response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM matched) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.record_count, 1.0 * g.record_count / t.total_count as fraction FROM grouped g, total t ORDER BY g.insurstat IS NULL, fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
